name: Hananoka Sumire
source:
Arcane Card: Paleturquoise of CUPS

The youngest member of Twilight Club, a junior who is acting as the club's secretary.

Sumire has a ladylike and quiet personality, and in addition to being the secretary, she serves the club like a maid and does miscellaneous work for all of the members. She has younger siblings at home and is a family-oriented person who takes good care of them while doing all the housework and cooking. She's like a mascot who is loved by everyone.

The protagonist, Tomori, is no exception. She's very considerate and helped him from time to time even when he messed up or did some questionable behaviors. However, she is a little too conscientious and always puts herself after everyone else, all the while keeping her feelings bottled up deep inside...

According to the other girls, she has the biggest cup size in the club despite her petite size.

"Ufufu... then let's have a cup of tea. Or maybe, would chocolate have been better?"

[Edited from [url=http://nanawind.jp/product/prj06/chapter2/]Official Website[/url]]
